status: Fixed local engineering trials on an already inspected archive, not independent validation
prior: Existing additive selector refit only on the current training fold, including its existing inner CV. Empirical timing prior derived from counts, not a physical timing identity.
residual: One shared numerical scorer across all candidates, 18 standardized static features. Linear residual control; tanh hidden width 8 for learned interactions, with a linear skip connection.
loss: Equal weight per shape. Log-latency squared error with half mass on host and half across observed fused candidates; plus exact expected relative regret over observed candidates (coefficient 0 for latency control, 1 otherwise); plus 0.001 L2 regularization.
policy: softmin(log predicted latency / 0.05); these weights are not calibrated probabilities
training: Analytic-gradient L-BFGS-B, at most 400 iterations and 900 function evaluations per start. Seeds 0 and 1 for nonlinear starts; select by training objective only. No outer-label hyperparameter search.
inference: Static candidates only; same hardware, host identity, axis domain and grouped-N support guards as before. Canonical ordering, exact ties prefer host then lexical family name. No near-tie margin.
acceptance: Unchanged primary, leave-K, 328 deletion decisions, previous attacks and 34 one-percent stresses for every variant; additionally require gradient, missing-label, order/subset stability, serialization and bounded-runtime tests.
stop_rule: Report all three predeclared results. Do not change features or objective in response to outer errors. Do not promote to default compiler or rewrite the frozen GPU package.
